submissionRoles.proofScopeNote: The sender identity does not change what the committed bytes and inclusion evidence prove.
insightResponsibilities: Provide the signed source and destination gates and their shared commitment fields
Run the pinned deterministic builder before the window against the literal vectors
Independently verify every published preimage, hash, transaction and inclusion fact after submission
Require any byte mismatch or canonicality failure to be published as an abort

preBroadcastGates: F17 canonical EIP-55 address fix and complete dependent-byte repin
N19 symmetric Bitcoin and Ethereum pre-publication canonicality checks
N20 explicit Bitcoin prefix, case and display-order types plus asymmetric literals
N22 byte agreement on the five-field Bitcoin preimage and VRT1/anchored-settlement-commitment leaf tag
Both pinned deterministic builders reproduce the shipped Bitcoin and Ethereum vectors
Live Bitcoin UTXO, Ethereum balance, nonce and fee conditions are rechecked
After the real gate fields exist, both parties independently recompute the same preimages before the first broadcast, without an in-window human round trip
standing: No transaction is authorized before every preBroadcastGate is satisfied
Not anchored until a real attempt is broadcast and included
The ordering proof does not prove the Insight verdict correct, checkedAt accurate or extend gate freshness
